description: Query Umami Analytics v3 — stats, funnels, retention, attribution, UTM. Read-only by default.
name: io.github.Asif2BD/umami-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Your Umami instance URL, e.g. https://analytics.example.com
environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_URL

environmentVariables.description: Umami username. Self-hosted Umami has no API keys, so a login is required.
environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Umami password. Prefer a dedicated, limited account over your admin login.
environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Umami Cloud API key, used instead of username and password.
environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Permission tier: read (default), write, or admin. Tools above the tier are never registered.
environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_MCP_MODE
